items.title: Jon Hendricks — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: He was another one that had come out of Leo Watson’s scat school, like I had come through Leo also.

ctx.x: You all just immediately struck it off?

I had heard him in my hometown. He was another one that had come out of Leo Watson’s scat school, like I had come through Leo also. He had also come through Bird, which is like Art Tatum, so we were on the same wavelength. He and his partner Buddy Stewart made some records for the Keynote label called – things like A Cent and a Half, Charge Account, What’s This?, which Nat Cole made a record to reply to, called That’s What, where he scatted. Nat Cole was very hip.
I didn’t know that. I didn’t know – I know about his – more of his ballad- type work.
